theorems.name: Submission.chartTD_immersion_local_biLipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → (∀ u ∈ V, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ u)) → ∀ u₀ ∈ V, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball u₀ r ⊆ V ∧ ∃ (K : ℝ≥0) (c : ℝ), 0 < c ∧ LipschitzOnWith K ψ (Metric.ball u₀ r) ∧ ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r, ∀ u' ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r, c * ‖u - u'‖ ≤ ‖ψ u - ψ u'‖
